title: Star Wars Instruments Pack
description: An addition of star wars music making items to brighten up your world! With cheap crafting recipes so you arent stuck in the mines for ages!
body:
![Star Wars Instruments!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6a0c944987c74c65bd0f603e73728ff834c1af32.png)
Welcome to the wonderful world of Star Wars where this mod adds iconic music instruments from the beloved franchise like:
-  an Astromech Synth that sounds like R2D2!
-  an Imperial Drum that resonates with the Imperial March theme!
-  a Kloo Horn that plays the iconic Cantina song!
-  a Clone radio that has battle sound affects for all your star wars needs!
